reason: In app/assets/javascripts/discourse/models/group.js:59, the return statement in addMembers ends with '})' and no semicolon. .jshintrc does not set asi, and its 'lastsemic: true' only allows a missing semicolon when the closing brace is on the same line, which it is not here (line 60), so jshint raises W033 'Missing semicolon'.
